* Responses to deploying a Star Destroyer only occur once (e.g. [[A Million Voices Crying Out]] retrieves 3, not 6).
* Works with actions that deploy/move one 'starship' but not cards that deploy/move one 'Star Destroyer' (e.g. cannot be deployed by [[Commander Nemet (V)]] or moved by [[On The Verge Of Greatness / Taking Control Of The Weapon{{!}}On The Verge Of Greatness]]).
* Works with other actions that target (not deploy/move) a Star Destroyer, such as [[Apology Accepted (V)]].
